description: This class, EngineSnifferStatusPanel, is a component of the user interface for a digital engine sniffer application. It displays status information such as time, angle, RPM, and provides mouse interaction to show details related to engine cycles and timing.

classes.name: EngineSnifferStatusPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel displaying real-time engine status information such as time, angle, RPM, with interactive mouse movement to show details.

methods.name: EngineSnifferStatusPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel with parts for displaying engine data, and setting up mouse motion listener.

methods.name: setTimeAxisTranslator
methods.description: Setter to update the TimeAxisTranslator used for converting screen to time coordinates.

methods.name: setRevolutions
methods.description: Updates the revolution log data used to determine crank angle based on time.
